_readme: Reference prices for private-company (pre-IPO) markets. Copy to private-markets.json, which git ignores:
anyone who reads a new price before it reaches the chain can trade against the vault.
price: pick one convention per market and keep it, e.g. implied valuation in $ billions or a per-share price.
asOf: date of the price (YYYY-MM-DD). Prices older than PRIVATE_MAX_AGE_DAYS (default 3) stop trading.
confirmPrice: set equal to price to apply a move larger than PRIVATE_MAX_JUMP (default 20%).
Symbols must end in -PRE and be at most 16 characters. The feeder re-reads this file every round.
